description:
[Calculators] Open a crate, barrel or NPC 1-1,000 times with the game's loot roll. Opens a Rust container with the loot roll ported from the game's server code (LootContainer.PopulateLoot ->
LootSpawn.SpawnIntoContainer -> Item.MoveToContainer; data from the server files, vanilla settings) - the engine
of https://rust.wiki/calculators/loot-simulator. Returns the haul: `items` totals (amount, how many opens had it,
average condition for items that spawn damaged), `scrap_value` (everything recycled at `recycler`, all the way
down, plus loot scrap), `lost_for_room` (loot destroyed because the container was full, as in game), the first
`breakdown` opens one by one, and `chance_per_open`: every item's exact chance of at least one per open and its
average amount (`chance_basis` says when a container that can fill up was simulated instead). `page` opens the
same result on the site. A seed reproduces a result; it doesn't predict a real server. Opens a Rust crate, barrel or NPC body with the loot roll ported from the game's server code (seeded: same container, count and seed = same loot). Use for 'what do I get from N locked crates' or 'odds of an AK from an elite crate' (chance_per_open; chance_basis says whether it's exact). Give the user the page link: it shows the same haul. Container keys: locked-crate, elite-crate, military-crate, supply-drop, bradley-crate, heli-crate, blue-barrel, scientist, heavy-scientist, ...

breakdown.description: How many of the opens to list one by one.

chances.description: How many rows of the exact chance-per-open table to include.

container.description: Container key or name, e.g. locked-crate, elite-crate, supply-drop, bradley-crate, heli-crate, military-crate, blue-barrel, scientist, heavy-scientist. A wrong name lists every key.

recycler.description: Recycler for scrap_value: recycler (monument, 50%), safe_zone (40%), powered (Power Plant grid stage 2+, 60%) or red (75%).

seed.description: a-z0-9 seed; the same container, count and seed always give the same loot (here and on the page). Random if left out.

name: simulate_crate_open
title: Open a crate, barrel or NPC 1-1,000 times with the game's loot roll
